newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 627 mln stg further help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 627 mln stg further help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 627 million stg of assistance at established interest rates.
The Bank allotted 318 million stg outright in bills maturing on or before May 7 and 309 million in repos to May 6 and 7.
It revised its forecast money market shortage to 1.65 billion stg from 1.75 billion.
In early operations, the Bank provided assistance worth 420 million stg.
